eval.title: Google Stock Analysis - Great Business At Fair Price

call.headline_quote: so if it crashes 20 25 you can expect a 10 return now we are at around 7 8 from google which is still great still a great business so nothing wrong with that

base_metric.name: fcf_per_share
base_metric.quote: we did just a quick valuation on free cash flows that are reinvested for growth

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: let's say that they grow at 15 over the next five years perhaps a little bit faster but let's say 15 then slow down to 10 discount rate terminal multiple 25 so a 4 cash flow yield could be higher will do that in the best case scenario and the intrinsic value is 1.1 trillion

scenarios.name: best

scenarios.name: worst

what_is_priced_in.quote: the forward price to earnings ratio is 34

reasons.claim: At a $1.5 trillion market cap versus a $1.2 trillion probability-weighted intrinsic value, google only offers a high single-digit return rather than his required 10%.
reasons.quote: the intrinsic value for a 10 return is 1.2 trillion compare that to the market capitalization and let's say that now the return from expected from google is seven eight percent over the next ten years

data_check.gap_note: he says 1.5, as-of 7.70681e+10 (FY2020); annual vs TTM or a different definition; not in our data: intrinsic value, expected return

reasons.claim: Google is a great business with high return on invested capital, a strengthening moat and a long growth runway, per Li Lu's framework.
reasons.quote: google has all of that emote high returns on invested capital profitability and a longer runway

reasons.claim: Cloud is a fast-growing, underappreciated segment with an exploding backlog that adds upside not priced in.
reasons.quote: the backlog is exploding as all those companies that they have mentioned here are ordering and buying more and more especially as more businesses are moving into cloud operations

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

reasons.claim: Various moonshot/other bets could unexpectedly generate billions in future revenue and are essentially free optionality not priced into the stock.
reasons.quote: you never know how will other other projects other bets like excess fiber calico capital ig gv verily waymo and x among others develop and when will reach 5 10 15 20 billion in revenues that's unknown however i don't think that is priced in

data_check.gap_note: trajectory visible at T0; no number stated

reasons.claim: Tech businesses carry inherent uncertainty (competition, regulation) so he would never put 100% of his portfolio into Google despite its quality.
reasons.quote: it's always tech it's always uncertain so i would never put 100 of my money in google

external_facts_used: Li Lu's interview framework on investing in great businesses (ROIC, moat, runway)
Analyst/bank target prices up to $3000, median $2400
Morningstar forward P/E of 34, ROE 19%, five-star bargain price of $1500
Cloud segment's first detailed investor presentation by the cloud CEO and market growth projections
